Description

I am submitting a bug report regarding an issue where VRChat fails to clear its content cache despite extensive troubleshooting. Even after closing the application and manually deleting the entire Cache folder located in %LocalAppData%Low\VRChat\VRChat, the in-game storage metrics and cached asset files persist or immediately re-index upon relaunch as if no deletion occurred. I have verified folder permissions to rule out read-only restrictions, tested launcher file integrity, and reinstalled the application entirely, yet the cache remains uncleared. I have attached my latest output logs detailing this failure for further diagnostic review.

Reproduction Steps

How to make this bug happen: No special steps are required. Simply launch VRChat, log in as usual, and navigate to the Debug/Storage settings. The content cache fails to clear automatically or display as empty, even after the cache folder has been manually deleted on the system prior to launching the application.

Details

- Category: Other

- Frequency: Always
